bitmap.rgbPolicy: Decoded JPEG RGB plus exact zlib alpha, without color correction or re-encoding JPEG.

frameMappingLimit: Source requests posterFrame=361+vang, vang=(yaw+rot.z) mod 360. SWF frames only 1..361. Native signed remainder, out-of-range posterFrame coercion and filtering are not proven. Raw transforms are authoritative; normalized angular selection must be labelled browser adapter.
